summary:
史賽克上一季 EPS 小幅超預期1.7%，營收7.17億美元，手術需求穩健。
• EPS 4.47 美元，較預估4.40超出1.70%。
• 營收7.17億美元（B級），季節性高峰穩固。
• Mako 機器人手術與骨科植入需求支撐成長。
• 本益比35.72，反映市場給予品質溢價。
ai_view:
訊號中性偏穩：EPS 小幅超預期，反映史賽克在骨科與機器人手術的領先地位與穩定執行。本季營收年增率未揭露，無法直接判斷加速度。短期股價靠品質與成長韌性支撐，中期看 Mako 滲透與新產品週期。追蹤指標：有機營收成長、Mako 裝機與耗材黏著度、毛利率。35.7倍本益比偏高，需後續季度持續交付以維持溢價。

需留意：營收年增率未提供，成長趨勢需後續確認。；醫院資本支出與器材定價壓力。；高估值要求持續穩定的獲利成長。

summary_en:
Stryker edged past EPS by 1.7% with $7.17B revenue, on steady surgical demand.
• EPS of $4.47 beat the $4.40 estimate by 1.70%.
• Revenue of $7.17B reflected a solid seasonal peak.
• Mako robotics and orthopedic implants support growth.
• P/E of 35.72 reflects a quality premium.

ai_view_en:
Signal is neutral-to-stable: a small EPS beat reflects Stryker's leadership in orthopedics and robotic surgery with steady execution. Revenue YoY was undisclosed, so acceleration can't be gauged directly. Near-term the stock leans on quality and growth resilience; mid-term watch Mako penetration and new-product cycles. Track organic revenue growth, Mako installs and consumable stickiness, and gross margin. A 35.7x P/E is elevated and needs consistent delivery to sustain the premium.

Watch：Revenue YoY was not provided, requiring later confirmation.; Hospital capex and device pricing pressure persist.; A high valuation demands consistent earnings growth.
beat_or_miss: 超預期：EPS 較預估高出1.70%，略優於市場共識。
